summary: {organizer} asks what a visitor can use to hear a presentation on the fairgrounds exhibit floor.
realLife: The Los Banos Fairgrounds survey found that the Exhibit Building had no assistive listening system.
gates: A county event schedules amplified speech in an exhibit space with a documented listening barrier.
inGame: needs: the presentation room, listening equipment and on-site test.

turns.what: Staff try a receiver on the exhibit floor.
turns.pulledBy: A loan system arrives before the event.
turns.writesBack: The setup log records the test location.

turns.what: Organizers investigate another space with listening equipment.
turns.pulledBy: No system is available for that room.
